input:
Earlier scenes:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

This scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：一个男人，This is a new, unspecified character. Use an indefinite noun phrase rather than a word that distinguishes “other people” from a stated person or group. [teacher rule: bieren]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 给他吃一个灵芝：给他吃了一个灵芝，The giving/feeding action is completed in this event, so the verb needs 了 before its object. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 写他发现的信息：写下他发现的信息，When recording discovered information, 写下 means to write it down and keep a record; 写 alone does not clearly express that recording meaning here. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种不能吃，哪一种 already asks which type of plant, so it should not be combined with the yes-or-no form 能不能. Use parallel clauses to state which plants are edible and which are not. [rule: none]

items.reason: 别人 cannot introduce one new individual here; 一个男人 is a grammatical indefinite reference.
This completed feeding action is the last action in the sequence and needs 了.
写他发现的信息 is already grammatical and can mean continuing to write the information he discovered.
哪一个植物 cannot be combined with 能不能 here; the edible and inedible plants need to be stated in parallel.
